motions.motion: recommend approval of the property at 6393 South Crest Mount Circle, applicant Christopher Allen, for single-family home development and driveway access on slopes designated by the FCOZ as sensitive and meet the Commission’s review. Approval was subject to the following: Conditions of Approval: 1. The Owner/Applicant shall obtain a Holladay Building Permit for the proposed structures to [or that may] be emplaced on the Property (a house and accessory building). 2. Relatedly [redundantly] to satisfying Condition No 1 above, the Owner/Applicant shall procure Unified Fire Department approval of the proposed driveway system to be associated with the Property’s development (as represented in those proposed plans provided to the City and Commission for review and approval). Further: the finished driveway shall not exceed 10% grade within 20’ of the right- of-way line of/for Crest Mount). 3. Applicant/project shall comply with standards listed in Holladay City Code Sections 13.72.030 & 13.72.040 of Holladay City Code in developing the Property. 4. City approval of the “Slope Waiver Request” does not, and shall not, abrogate the Applicant’s/Owner’s responsibility to comply with any relevant deed restriction(s) and/or covenants, conditions, and restrictions (CC&Rs) that may be assigned to the Property. 5. Any other conditions as may be imposed by the Commission to promote the general health, safety, and welfare in the neighborhood surrounding the Property.
